prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headache beginning shortly after the incident. On initial examination, cervical range of motion was reduced in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the upper extremities, was within normal limits. Imaging was not felt to be necessary given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over five visits, the patient was managed with a combination of manual therapy, targeted stretching, postural education, and a home exercise program. Pain scores and range of motion improved steadily across the course of care, and headache frequency decreased after the third visit. Muscle tension was reduced at each follow-up, and the patient reported improved sleep and tolerance for daily activities.

At the most recent visit, cervical motion was near baseline with only mild residual discomfort on end-range rotation. The patient was counseled on continuing the home exercise program, avoiding prolonged static postures, and returning promptly if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop. Discharge from active care is recommended with follow-up as needed.
